soundness_flags.one_line: Under the stated affine witness, q1=73/64 and q2=129/128 (not 85/64 and 159/128), so det(X_v^T X_v)=5619/8192 rather than 10191/8192.

source_verification_receipts.version: PNAS 121(40), e2322232121 (2024), open-access published article mirror
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article presents first-order technical results and a strongly consistent TTE estimator; it labels finite-sample-error analysis of its CI procedure as a future research direction and uses the Section 2.5 resampling heuristic in numerical illustrations.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1–2, Abstract and Introduction; pp. 4–6, Section 3 and Algorithm 1; p. 10, Conclusion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper constructs FO-CMP/HO-CMP estimators by learning state-evolution updates from mean, variance, treatment, and nonlinear features, and evaluates them through simulations; the inspected proceedings text states no analytic root-N joint covariance, feasible influence covariance, or coverage theorem.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair and retain the affine T=3 calculation as a checked regression table: replace q1,q2 and the determinant with their correct values, then recompute the claimed mean-fluctuation and reuse components from the same recursion.

State a finite-N coupling or equality-in-law bridge from the observed reused-G array to the auxiliary-Z empirical recursion, then make that bridge an explicit dependency of the parameter and band laws.

Add a sharply delimited comparison theorem against the published Causal-MP CI heuristic—for example, identify the precise omitted same-matrix covariance term and show when the heuristic band under- or over-covers.

recommended_next_step: Revise the affine sanity reduction and explicitly state the observed-array-to-conditioning-recursion bridge, then advance the repaired field-tier CFSE kernel to Stage 0.
